messages:
sam (partnerships): Quick catch-up: partner asks for a "VectorHub" bundle in AWS Marketplace listing — includes Snowflake connector, Databricks notebook, and demo with Qdrant & Milvus. They also asked us to confirm A100 and A10x hardware certification docs. Who can run the final end-to-end test matrix?
nina (eng-runtime): I can run the matrix. note: Snowflake External Functions and UDFs behave differently; we should test both. will need access to partner Snowflake dev account and a Databricks workspace.
harry (field-eng): I can do the vector DB tests (Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone). plan: ingest 20k vectors (256d) and run 5k nearest queries, capture p50/p95/p99. I'll use this script: `python bench_vectors.py --store qdrant --n 20000 --dim 256`
tom (partner-eng): Partner provided sample dataset and their infra contacts. I'll request the dev accounts now. also flag: partner wants co-branded marketplace tile and a short joint announcement in April.
maya (product): timeline: internal deadline Apr 12 for the marketplace draft, partner preview Apr 16, public Apr 30. legal wants data-flow diagram + privacy bullets before partner preview. publish-bot, can you post the checklist?
publish-bot: Marketplace checklist (drive): https://drive.redwood/marketplace/vectorhub-checklist (items: legal signoff, billing SKU, tile assets, HW cert PDFs, sample app). :page_facing_up:
nina (eng-runtime): found an issue when running quantized model inside Snowflake UDF sandbox: KV cache dtype mismatch. quick repro: ```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "udf_handler.py", line 22, in handler
    out = model.generate(inp)
RuntimeError: KV cache dtype float16 not supported in sandbox```
harry (field-eng): interesting. Databricks runtime didn't hit that problem in our runs. could be the UDF's restricted native lib loading. tom, can partner allow a small wrapper env var to preload the quant shim?
tom (partner-eng): I'll ask. partner legal might push back on additional binaries; prefer env var approach.
maya (product): decision: target Apr 30 public unless partner preview good by Apr 16. owners: nina (runtime fixes + Snowflake repro), harry (vector perf + reports), tom (partner infra + legal coordination), maya (marketplace tile + announcement). Sam will run weekly checkpoint.
sam (partnerships): I'll schedule a standing 30m checkpoint starting Mon. harry, post perf CSV to /reports/partners/1819991111. nina, open an issue for the UDF shim problem and link PR once ready.
harry (field-eng): will do. rough perf note: Qdrant ingest ~7k vectors/s on 4x vCPUs, p95 query ~120ms at k=10. will validate on partner infra too.
nina (eng-runtime): opening PART-5012 "Snowflake UDF: KV cache dtype in sandbox" and prototyping a preload shim. ETA prototype Tue EOD.
tom (partner-eng): partner asks about HW screenshots for the market tile (nvidia-smi, perf governor). harry/nina coordinate with infra to capture A100/A10x screenshots.
sam (partnerships): thanks all — ping #release-war-room if anything blocks. I'll post the invite and checklist link.
